body:
**What does this PR do?**

Reduces ordinary numeric `Instance.Invoke` latency by 26.2% on M4 Max, from 10.425 ns to 7.694 ns with zero allocations. Prepared and wider numeric calls also improve; host callback round trips remain within benchmark variation.

**How does this PR do it?**

Stores instance lifetime leases and invocation-gate flags in separate halves of one atomic word, allowing uncontended numeric calls to acquire and release both with one CAS each. Contended, closing, and revoked calls retain the existing handoff and finalization paths. The ordinary Invoke path also checks the first export-cache slot directly and caches bounded i32 entry eligibility.

**What changes are made/proposed?**

* Share lifetime/gate admission across ordinary and prepared numeric entry paths.
* Preserve independent updates to either state half, Runtime accounting, guest-storage borrowing checks, and native entry eligibility.
* Add tests for concurrent state updates, waiting lifetime leases, Close finalization, revoker notification, and equal export names with distinct string storage; update footprint assertions and changelog.

**Deltas**

Compared with main at `2286d676facdfa1cabe2d1c61072e505438ca7f2`, using Go 1.27.1 on ARM64 M4 Max. Eight paired blocks alternated baseline/change order, with 200 ms per benchmark sample and no concurrent builds. Values are medians; negative latency deltas indicate improvement.

| Benchmark | Main | This PR | Latency delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| i32 → i32 Invoke | 10.425 ns | 7.694 ns | −26.2% |
| i32 → i32 prepared | 9.165 ns | 7.874 ns | −14.1% |
| 4 i32 → 4 i32 Invoke | 17.835 ns | 14.610 ns | −18.1% |
| 4 i32 → 4 i32 prepared | 17.335 ns | 14.425 ns | −16.8% |
| Alternating exports (three calls/iteration) | 36.425 ns | 30.485 ns | −16.3% |
| Invoke host callback round trip | 103.450 ns | 104.200 ns | +0.7% |

The numeric entry benchmarks retain zero allocations. The callback benchmark retains its existing one allocation. AMD64 was compile-checked; performance figures above are ARM64 measurements.

Validation:

* `go test ./src/wago ./src/core/runtime .`
* Focused admission, gate, ownership, lifetime, and cache tests under `-race`, repeated five times.
* `go test -tags=wago_regalloccheck ./src/wago ./src/core/runtime .`
* Focused admission, gate, cache, and prepared entry tests with `wago_profile`.
* Linux AMD64 test-binary compilation and `go vet ./src/wago ./src/core/runtime`.

- [x] I've read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/wago-org/wago/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I've added my name and email to the [NOTICE](https://github.com/wago-org/wago/blob/main/NOTICE) file (already present)
- [x] I've updated the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/wago-org/wago/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [x] I use a LLM to assist with this PR

AI assistance: Codex helped investigate entry overhead, implement the optimization and regression tests, and run paired benchmarks and validation. The patch was reviewed before submission.
title: Reduce ordinary host-to-Wasm call latency by 26%
